items.heading: Amendments to Title 23 (Zoning) to permit by-right approval of qualifying housing projects on sites identified in previous Housing Elements, and revisions related to Design Review
items.action: Action: M/S/C (Kesarwani/Taplin) to adopt the first reading of Ordinance No. 8,000– N.S. as amended in Section 23.406.070 by Councilmember Kesarwani below. Second reading scheduled for February 10, 2026. 23.406.070 Design Review B. When Required. 1. Design Review is required for: (a) Projects in all Non-Residential Districts, except for Residential Uses in the MU-R zoning district. (b) Mixed use and community and institutional projects in the R-3 district within the Southside Plan area. See Figure 23.202-1: R-3 Areas Subject to Design Review; and (c) Commercial, mixed-use, and community and institutional projects in the R-4, R-SMU, and R-S districts. 2. Projects Not Requiring a Use Permit. (a) For a project that does not require a Use Permit, Department staff conducts Design Review before the Zoning Officer takes action on the required permit or approval. (b) The Zoning Officer will consider the Design Review recommendations when acting on the required permit or approval. The Zoning Officer may require modifications to the project design as a condition of approval. Action Calendar – Public Hearings (c) The Department will verify conformance with Design Review recommendations and design-related conditions of approval when issuing a building permit, sign permit, or Zoning Certificate for the project. Final Design Review is not required. (d) Multi-Unit Residential in the MU-R, and Housing Element Opportunity Site Projects (BMC Section 23.302.070(M)): 1. For projects including 5 or more units, Staff shall schedule a single consultation meeting of the Design Review Committee for non-binding input on design-related issues; and 2. Staff-level design review conducted under this section shall not be subject to the Appeal provisions of 23.406.070(O). Vote: All Ayes.
